title: 第1章：丧尸爆发，破房车变成无敌堡垒了？
slug: 丧尸爆发我的房车能无限升级
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“哥们儿，你这房车……确定不是从废品站论斤称回来的？”

林昊把手机怼到车头前，镜头扫过那辆锈迹斑斑的二手房车。

漆面大片脱落，左侧车门变形了关不严，得用脚暴力踹一下才能合上，挡风玻璃右下角还裂着一道狰狞的口子，拿透明胶带糊了好几层。

直播间的弹幕疯了。

“这破烂也好意思叫房车？我奶的轮椅都比这豪华！”

“主播是不是穷得裤衩都当了哈哈哈哈哈！”

“我家拖拉机开出来都比这体面，真的。”

“建议改名——移动铁棺材体验之旅，开着开着就散架了。”

林昊靠在冰凉的车身上，冲镜头咧嘴一笑。

“各位，穷游穷游，重点在一个‘穷’字。能遮风挡雨，能睡个觉，四个轮子还能跑，要啥自行车？”

他翻了个身，抬手拍了拍车顶，手掌下传来“噗”的一声闷响，几片锈皮应声簌簌往下掉。直播间在线人数可怜地卡在两百出头，大部分是等着看他笑话的。

林昊不在乎。

做了三个月穷游博主，他早就习惯了这种嘲讽。

全网粉丝加起来不到八千，一分钱没赚到，每条视频评论区最热门的永远是那句：“卖了这破车，够你下三回馆子了。”

但这车，是他现在唯一的家当。

他正打算拉开车门，给观众展示一下那个被他用纸箱和编大妈同款编织袋精心改造过的“卧室”，服务区大厅里的巨幅电子屏突然切了画面。

刺眼的红色新闻横幅滚过屏幕。

“紧急通报——我国多地同时爆发不明病毒，感染者呈现极端攻击性，已造成多起恶性伤亡事件。政府紧急呼吁：全体市民立即留在室内，关闭门窗，等待进一步通知……”

林昊愣了一下，把手机镜头转向大屏幕，直播画面正好把通报拍了个正着。

弹幕风向瞬间变了。

“假的吧？什么电影宣传片？”

“主播你配合得挺好啊，这剧本多少钱一条？”

“卧槽我刚手贱搜了一下，微博热搜爆了……不会是真的吧？”

林昊盯着屏幕上反复滚动的血红字幕，脑子嗡的一声，有点懵。

他现在的位置是G50高速公路边上一个不大不小的服务区，周围稀稀拉拉十来个旅客，有人在便利店买水，有人在抽烟区低头刷着手机。

没一个人把这通报当回事。

电视上的东西，搞不好又是哪个专家在吓唬人。

下一秒，一道凄厉的尖叫撕开了整个大厅的平静。

林昊猛地回头——便利店方向，一个浑身是血的男人从外面撞了进来！他的动作极其诡异，跑得歪歪扭扭，两条腿以一种活人绝不可能做到的角度扭曲着。

收银台后面那个扎着马尾的女店员刚抬起头，男人已经饿虎扑食般撞上收银台，半个身子压了上去，对着她的脖子就是一口！

“咔嚓！”

一声像是咬断脆骨的清晰声响传来。

女店员的惨叫瞬间拔高到极致，又戛然而止，被某种湿漉漉的、令人头皮发麻的咀嚼声取代。

林昊的手机还在直播，镜头不偏不倚地对着那个方向。弹幕瞬间被刷成一片白屏——

“卧槽卧槽卧槽卧槽！”

“这是真的？？？杀人了！！！”

“报警啊！！！主播快报警！！！”

“跑！主播快跑啊！！！”

鲜血溅到了旁边货架的薯片包装袋上，是那种刺眼的暗红色，比番茄酱稠得多，一滴一滴黏腻地往下淌。

服务区里的人只愣了不到两秒。

“Brother, are you sure this RV of yours didn’t come back from a scrap yard weighing?”

Lin Hao held his cell phone in front of the car, and the camera scanned the rusty second-hand RV.

Large areas of paint peeled off, and the left door was deformed and could not be closed tightly. It had to be violently kicked with the foot to close it. There was also a hideous gash in the lower right corner of the windshield, which was covered with several layers of scotch tape.

The barrage in the live broadcast room is crazy.

"How dare you call this rag a RV? Even my grandma's wheelchair is more luxurious than this one!"

"Is the anchor so poor that his pants are all gone? Hahahaha!"

"My tractors are more decent than this, really."

"It is recommended to change the name - the mobile iron coffin experience tour, it falls apart when it is opened."

Lin Hao leaned on the cold car and grinned at the camera.

"Everyone, when traveling on a budget, the key is the word 'poor'. I can shelter from the wind and rain, sleep, and run on four wheels. What kind of bicycle do I need?"

He turned over and raised his hand to pat the roof of the car. There was a muffled "pop" sound under his palm, and a few pieces of rusty skin fell down.The number of people online in the live broadcast room was pitifully in the early 200s, and most of them were waiting to see his jokes.

Lin Hao didn't care.

After working as a Qiongyou blogger for three months, he has long been accustomed to this kind of ridicule.

The total number of fans on the entire network is less than 8,000, and I have not earned a penny. The most popular comment section of each video is always the sentence: "Selling this shabby car will be enough for you to go to the restaurant three times."

But this car is his only possession now.

He was about to open the car door and show the audience the "bedroom" that he had carefully transformed using cardboard boxes and woven bags made of the same style as Auntie's, when the huge electronic screen in the lobby of the service area suddenly cut off the screen.

A harsh red news banner scrolled across the screen.

"Emergency notification - An unknown virus broke out in many places in our country at the same time. The infected people were extremely aggressive and have caused many vicious casualties. The government urgently appeals to all citizens to stay indoors immediately, close doors and windows, and wait for further notice..."

Lin Hao was stunned for a moment and turned the camera of his mobile phone to the big screen. The live broadcast captured the announcement.

The direction of the barrage changed instantly.

"It's fake, right? What kind of movie promotion video?"

"Anchor, you are very cooperative. How much does this script cost?"

"Damn it, I just did a quick search, and it was a hot topic on Weibo... It can't be true, can it?"

Lin Hao stared at the red subtitles scrolling repeatedly on the screen, his head buzzing, and he was a little confused.

His current location is a medium-sized service area on the edge of the G50 highway. There are a dozen or so tourists around, some are buying water at a convenience store, and some are scrolling through their mobile phones in the smoking area.

No one took the notice seriously.

The things on TV might be some expert trying to scare people.

The next second, a shrill scream tore through the silence of the entire hall.

Lin Hao turned around suddenly - in the direction of the convenience store, a man covered in blood bumped in from the outside!His movements were extremely weird, he ran crookedly, and his legs were twisted at an angle that was impossible for a living person to do.

Just as the ponytailed female clerk behind the checkout counter raised her head, the man had already bumped into the checkout counter like a hungry tiger, half of his body pressed down on her, and he gave her a bite on the neck!

"Crack!"

There was a clear sound like biting a brittle bone.

The female clerk's screams suddenly reached a peak, then stopped abruptly, and were replaced by some kind of wet, scalp-numbing chewing sound.

Lin Hao's mobile phone was still broadcasting live, and the camera was pointed in that direction.The barrage was instantly turned into a blank screen——

"Holy shit, shit, shit, shit!"

"Is this true??? Murder!!!"

"Call the police!!! Anchor, call the police!!!"

"Run! Anchor, run quickly!!!"

Blood spattered on the potato chip bags on the shelf next to it. It was a dazzling dark red color, much thicker than ketchup, and dripped down drop by drop.

The people in the service area were stunned for less than two seconds.
